snippet.title: Litany and Sigils of Nightfall | Deep Dive | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Litany
Litany is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play multiple units, craft a hyper-synergistic group, and trigger results that should not exist. Pick a character, open boosters, upgrade cards, and craft a powerful combination that breaks the numbers!


Obtenlo/Get It/ Obtê-lo/ここで購入:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4227270/Litany/


Sigils of Nightfall
Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive the horrors that will unleash the world's end.


Obtenlo/Get It/ Obtê-lo/ここで購入:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3039980/Sigils_of_Nightfall/
